items.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: by going to Jimmy Ryan’s and being knocked out by the Sidney DeParis- Wilbur DeParis aggregation

ctx.x: So did you get a taste of Hamilton, did you do any concert promotion or anything like —

No. I did nothing. At that time I didn’t have a whole lot of money. I was barely getting by although I can’t say I ever suffered any hardship. But I was more collecting, I was more learning, I was reading, I was, I even bid on some records. I was more of a record collector. Now what I learned at Hamilton was how to write a thesis or, you know, with footnotes, and go to sources and all of that, which stood me in good stead later. Because later I wrote some articles and also I did research. But my interest at that…
